change: Only add aggregate expected-unit fill constraint to original cost objective: mean_s sum_i shortage_i_s <= (1-target)*mean_s sum_i demand_i_s. Same eight synchronized scenarios, price, opening stock, packs, forecast, resource limits and penalties. Not each-SKU, each-scenario, probability-of-no-stockout or observed service guarantee.
scope: All 12 preselected items and all 12 known development origins, two forecasts and six resource combinations, shortage price ratio fixed at 1.5. Historical feedback acknowledged; no independent or causal claim. Do not select target/default or discard windows using realized costs.
feasibility: Also minimize expected shortage under identical resources to bound maximum attainable aggregate fill. Preserve certified optimum, infeasible, timeout and error states. No silent fallback or changed resources. Zero demand has no service percentage; display undefined.
comparison: Retain point, buffer and unconstrained-service cost optimum for every configuration. Recompute their target eligibility. Compare service-constrained cost to rule only with shared resources and explicit eligibility; report same-service eligible subsets separately, all infeasible windows and all observed regressions. Aggregate fill by total demand, not mean percentages.
freeze: Save all solver orders and statuses without actuals before attaching existing known outcomes from parent. Do not refit scenarios or forecasts, read raw labels, create perfect-information orders or use marginal interval upper bounds as joint scenarios.
units: All internal money pence; UI pounds. Independent windows reset stock. Sales proxy and assumed cost/stock are not real accounting profit.
